subject: biology-9
chapterTitle: Federal Board Full-Book Grand Exam Simulator (Ch 1–10)
description: Comprehensive 12-mark Section A Federal Board full-book examination simulator covering all 10 curriculum chapters by Lecturer Rubina Ashraf.

questions.question: Which of the following is classified as an insoluble structural fibrous protein?
questions.explanation: Keratin provides structural integrity and water impermeability to hair, nails, feathers, and horns.

questions.question: Studying the biomechanics of animal locomotion using physical principles belongs to:
questions.explanation: Biophysics applies principles of physics (levers, pressure, electricity) to biological structures and movements.

questions.question: If the tissue level of organization fails to form, which subsequent level cannot develop?
questions.explanation: Organs represent higher-order assemblies of tissues; without tissues, organs and organ systems cannot form.

questions.question: During aerobic respiration, in which stage is carbon dioxide primarily liberated?
questions.explanation: Oxidative decarboxylation of pyruvate and the Krebs cycle release carbon atoms as carbon dioxide.

questions.question: The human vermiform appendix is a textbook anatomical example of a/an:
questions.explanation: Vestigial organs are evolutionary remnants that have lost their ancestral digestive function.

questions.question: What chemical bonds stabilize complementary base pairs across antiparallel DNA strands?
questions.explanation: Hydrogen bonds between purines and pyrimidines hold the double helix together while allowing replication unzipping.

questions.question: Which of the following structures in an angiosperm seed is NOT part of the diploid embryo?
questions.explanation: The endosperm is triploid nutritive tissue formed separately by triple fusion, distinct from the diploid embryo.

questions.question: Non-competitive enzyme inhibitors bind to the:
questions.explanation: Non-competitive inhibitors bind to allosteric sites, changing the tertiary enzyme shape and inactivating catalysis.

questions.question: Which specialized conducting cells in the leaf vein are responsible for water transport?
questions.explanation: Xylem vessels transport water and dissolved inorganic ions from roots to photosynthetic leaf tissues.

questions.question: Which of the following organelles is normally absent in higher plant cells?
questions.explanation: Centrioles are absent in flowering plants, which organize mitotic spindles without centrosomal centrioles.

questions.question: A tentative explanation formulated on the basis of biological observations is called a:
questions.explanation: A hypothesis is an initial testable proposition formulated to explain biological observations.

questions.question: The scientific discipline dealing with the classification and evolutionary relationships of organisms is:
questions.explanation: Systematics combines taxonomic classification with evolutionary history and phylogenetic trees.
